label: 🔧 Convert units (Pint)
description: Convert a numeric column between any pair of compatible units using the Pint library. Supports length, mass, time, energy, pressure, temperature, electric charge, etc. — anything Pint understands. The output column has the converted values; the original column is preserved unless you rename.

from_unit.label: From unit
from_unit.help: e.g. meter, mile, kg, pound, celsius, joule
